parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the user group.

parameters.name: Marker
parameters.description: The marker. If the response is truncated, you can use this parameter to obtain the content that starts from the position after the truncation.

parameters.name: MaxItems
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return. If the response is truncated because it reaches the `MaxItems` limit, the `IsTruncated` response parameter is set to `true`.

Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100.
